title: Oat Banana Protein Cookies
description: Chewy baked cookies made with mashed banana, oats and whey powder — naturally sweetened.
steps: Mix the mashed banana with almond butter and egg.
Fold in the oats, protein powder and salt.
Drop spoonfuls onto a lined tray and bake at 175C for 15 minutes.

source.label: Adapted from Minimalist Baker recipe index

notes: Banana's natural sweetness plus oat fiber slows digestion — these hold blood sugar steadier than a shop-bought cookie.
